questions.question: How did Meta's average monthly closing price move during 2025?
questions.system_sql: SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', trade_date) AS DATE) AS month, ROUND(AVG(close)) AS avg_close FROM daily_prices WHERE ticker = 'META' AND trade_date >= '2025-01-01' AND trade_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 500
questions.answer: Meta's average monthly closing price moved from $632 in January to $657 in December 2025.

questions.question: What was Microsoft's year-over-year revenue growth, as a percentage, in each quarter of fiscal 2026?
questions.system_sql: SELECT cur.fiscal_quarter, ROUND((cur.revenue - prev.revenue) / prev.revenue * 100, 2) AS yoy_growth_pct FROM income_statements AS cur JOIN income_statements AS prev ON prev.ticker = cur.ticker AND prev.fiscal_year = cur.fiscal_year - 1 AND prev.fiscal_quarter = cur.fiscal_quarter WHERE cur.ticker = 'MSFT' AND cur.fiscal_year = 2026 ORDER BY cur.fiscal_quarter LIMIT 500
questions.answer: Microsoft's year-over-year revenue growth in fiscal 2026 was 18.43% in Q1, 16.72% in Q2, 18.3% in Q3, and 17.75% in Q4.
